rows.note: Use this all-purpose noun when discussing the length or duration of something, including how brief a reply is, but not a person's stature.

example.english: The shortness of this email makes it easy to read.
example.traditional: 呢封電郵嘅長短啱啱好，睇落唔會攰。
example.jyutping: ne1 fung1 din6 jau4 ge3 coeng4 dyun2 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 tai2 lok6 m4 wui5 gui6

rows.note: Use this for shortness in physical height, especially when comparing a person's stature.

example.english: When they stand together, the shortness of one of them really stands out.
example.traditional: 佢哋兩個企埋一齊，高矮差成截。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 kei5 maai4 jat1 cai4 gou1 ai2 caa1 sing4 zit6

rows.jyutping: A ge3 gaan2 git3 cing4 dou6
rows.note: Use this when specifically discussing how concise or terse a reply or piece of writing is.

example.english: I think the shortness of this letter is just right.
example.traditional: 我覺得呢封信嘅簡潔程度幾好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 fung1 seon3 ge3 gaan2 git3 cing4 dou6 gei2 hou2
